entities.summary: Counter-Reformation & Ottoman Frontier, a transformative movement in Slovenia (1600–1809). Emerged from Jurij Dalmatin publishes the complete Bible in Slovenian and Primož Trubar & the Slovenian Reformation. Catalyzed Napoleon establishes the Illyrian Provinces with capital at Ljubljana.
